ContactCount.title: ContactCount
ContactCount.description: Number of Contact records returned. Zero if no contacts matched the search criteria.

ResultsSummary.title: ResultsSummary
ResultsSummary.description: Formatted summary of matching Contact records including name, title, account, email, and phone. One record per line. Empty string if ContactCount is zero.

ErrorMessage.title: ErrorMessage
ErrorMessage.description: Error message if the search could not be executed. Empty string if no error occurred.
